children: France’s state budget deficit widened to EUR 145.9 billion in January-July 2026 from EUR 142 billion in the same period last year, as expenditure growth continued to outpace revenue growth.
General budget revenues increased 4.2% year-on-year to EUR 201.2 billion, while expenditures rose 4.6% to EUR 284.2 billion.
Excluding tax refunds and rebates, net tax revenues increased to EUR 182.9 billion, supported by higher personal income tax, VAT, corporate income tax, and other tax revenues.
Non-tax revenues also rose to EUR 18.3 billion, mainly due to the return of unused investment funds.
Meanwhile, higher expenditures reflected rising interest rates and inflation, increased military spending, and higher public service energy charges.
Special Treasury accounts posted a EUR 22.5 billion deficit, improving from a EUR 27.1 billion shortfall a year earlier.

title: France Budget Deficit Widens in Jan-Jul
